## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Directory plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/gov-benefit-flows/ is created
- [ ] >=11 YAML files exist, each with valid frontmatter: rule_id (unique), prior_art, precedence, domain: gov-benefit-flows, tags (including appropriate sub-tags)

- [ ] check-corpus-schema.sh passes on all new files
- [ ] ref-query.py returns >=1 result for query 'one question per page' with domain filter gov-benefit-flows
- [ ] plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_index.yaml is updated with all new file entries
- [ ] All tests in test_corpus_gov_benefit_flows.py pass (GREEN)

- DD2: >=1 policy-context entry for SNAP lifecycle stages (application, verification, eligibility, recertification, reporting)
- DD3: All entries schema-valid with required fields
